retrieved_chunks.text: Report a damaged, defective, expired, wrong or missing item within **48 hours of delivery**, with photos of the item and the packaging. This applies to every category, including grocery and other non-returnable items.
Reports after 48 hours are handled as a normal return if the item is still within its return window. Otherwise the customer can use the brand or ZentroMart Assured warranty, if any.
After verification the customer gets a free replacement or a full refund, including delivery fees. No reverse pickup fee applies.
Physical damage, liquid damage, normal wear and unauthorised repairs are not covered.
डिलीवरी के 48 घंटे के अंदर सामान और पैकेट की फ़ोटो के साथ शिकायत करें। जाँच के बाद मुफ़्त रिप्लेसमेंट या पूरा रिफ़ंड मिलेगा।
The ticket summary must contain: the customer's issue, the detected intent, the order ID if any, what the customer has already told you, what you already checked, and the reason for escalation.
